title: Managers: Are Drivers Enrolled in Safety
body: If you have enabled Safety Training through Beans Route, you can check to see how many drivers are enrolled and confirm who is enrolled in the program.  From the Mobile App: To see how many drivers are enrolled: 1.  From the Dispatch tab, click the Menu Bars on the top right of the screen and choose Settings > Preferences > Safety.               To see who is enrolled: 2.  Click the Menu Bars on the top right of the screen and choose Settings > Drivers and Dispatchers.  The driver list will indicate which drivers are enrolled in safety.                 Video:  How to see if Drivers are enrolled in Safety
